title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The graph below gives information about the percentage of the population in four Asian countries living in cities from 1970 to 2020, with predictions for 2030 and 2040.
scenario: The graph shows the percentage of the population living in cities in the Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia from 1970 to 2040.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
